notes: 20 quarters, Q3'21-Q2'26. Q3'21-Q4'23 come from the IPO prospectus (424B4, 'Unaudited Quarterly Results of Operations Data'), and 2023 ties to later 10-Qs. Q1'24 onward come from XBRL. Revenue is mostly advertising plus data licensing ('other'), so the model is transactional (advertising). Gross margin is GAAP (none reported on an adjusted basis). No adjusted operating margin is reported (adjusted EBITDA 342.8 = 42.6% in Q2'26), so the scorer uses GAAP 28.8%. TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): FCF 1,018.6 (OCF less PP&E 7.4) on revenue 2,778.8. Net cash = cash 1,486.8 + marketable securities 1,299.5 at 6/30/26; no debt; operating leases (~20.9) excluded. Reddit reports no non-GAAP EPS, so ttm_pe and eps_growth use GAAP diluted EPS (GAAP EPS bears stock-based compensation, so it understates an adjusted EPS): TTM 0.80+1.24+1.01+1.25=4.30 vs 0.16+0.36+0.13+0.45=1.10. NRR is not applicable. Price $147.86 at the 2026-10-02 close.
